name: Grace Liu
education: B.S. in Computer Engineering, University of Washington
summary: DevOps engineer with 2 years of experience shipping Dockerized services to Kubernetes with GitHub Actions pipelines on AWS, still building depth in infrastructure tooling.
strengths: Builds and maintains GitHub Actions pipelines that deploy Docker images to Kubernetes
Practical AWS usage across ECR, EKS, and managed runners
Writes Python tooling to automate release and health-check tasks
gaps: No Terraform experience - infrastructure is managed with CloudFormation and the AWS console
Limited direct Linux administration; relies on managed runners and pre-built AMIs
Junior-level exposure to production hardening and capacity planning
resumeText: Grace Liu is a DevOps Engineer at Pinevale Retail with two years of experience containerizing services and automating deployments. She owns GitHub Actions pipelines that build Docker images and roll them out to a Kubernetes cluster on AWS. She is now focused on growing into infrastructure as code with Terraform and deeper Linux operations to complement her app-side DevOps skills.
